notes: Read all 184 source lines with a numbered view before editing.

L1 `import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react'`: useEffect/useState/useCallback preserved (useEffect now seeds the native selection-store default + the outside-click/Escape effect is replaced by a Modal). useRef (containerRef) is dropped because the DOM container ref it pointed at — used only for `containerRef.current.contains(e.target)` outside-click detection — has no RN analogue; native adds useMemo + useSyncExternalStore for the native selection store.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'`: react-i18next is web-only; replaced by the native-safe `useNativeTranslationFallback` (key, fallback) shim. All five t() keys + English fallbacks are copied verbatim (statusBar.vehicle.fallback/none/tooltip/aria/switch).

L3 `import { Car, Check, ChevronUp } from 'lucide-react'`: lucide is DOM/SVG-only (contract rule 4). Mapped to bare SemanticIcon glyph text — Car -> getSemanticIconDefinition('vehicle').glyph ('EV'), Check -> 'confirm' ('OK'), ChevronUp -> 'collapse' ('^') with the rotate-180 closed state -> 'expand' ('v'). Rendered as muted caption AppText (the tiny-inline-icon convention used by sibling parity ports), no icon box.

L4 `import { Tooltip } from '@/components/ui'`: there is no native Tooltip (and no hover on touch). The composed tooltip text is surfaced as `accessibilityHint` on the chip/button — the established parity mapping for web tooltips/titles.

L5 `import { useSelectedVehicle } from '@/hooks/useSelectedVehicle'`: the web hook composes react-router `useMatch`/`useSearchParams` with the localStorage-backed SelectedVehicleProvider. Both are browser-only (contract rule 7). Reproduced as a native `useSelectedVehicle()` in-file: the REAL native `useVehicles()` supplies the list; selection lives in a module-level value + listener set read via `useSyncExternalStore` (native analogue of the persistent store), seeded to the first vehicle exactly as the web hook defaults. The URL-precedence layer is dropped (no RN router) and documented.

L6 `import { useVehicleState } from '@/api/hooks/useVehicles'`: uses the REAL native hook from ../../../api/hooks/useVehicles (already ported); imported together with its `Vehicle` and `VehicleState` types for the selection result + metrics guard.

L7 `import { useUnits } from '@/hooks/useUnits'`: useUnits reads the settings provider, which the parity tree lacks (see Delta / data-display/format). Replaced by the optional `distanceUnit` prop defaulting to the web no-settings value 'km' (deriveDistance(undefined) === 'km'); `unitPrefs.distance` -> `distanceLabel`.
L8 `import { convertDistanceFromSI } from '@/lib/unitConversion'`: ported inline with the same metres->mi (/1609.344) and metres->km (/1000) math the native data-display/format barrel uses.
L9 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'`: clsx+tailwind-merge class merging has no role in RN; replaced by StyleSheet style arrays. Each `className` becomes the native `style` prop.

L11-21 component JSDoc (footer status-bar segment; click opens a popover to switch vehicles; hidden for single-vehicle owners and during fleet-load): preserved + adapted into the file header and the ActiveVehicleSegment doc comment, documenting the native host substitutes (selection store, distanceUnit, Modal popover).

L23-25 `interface ActiveVehicleSegmentProps { iconOnly?: boolean }`: preserved as ActiveVehicleSegmentProps with `iconOnly?: boolean`; native additionally adds the documented optional `distanceUnit?` (useUnits substitute), `style?` (web root className) and `testID?`.

L27 `export function ActiveVehicleSegment({ iconOnly = false }: ...)`: named export + `iconOnly = false` default preserved; destructure extended with `distanceUnit = 'km'`, `style`, `testID`. `ActiveVehicleSegment.displayName` added per parity-tree convention.
L28 `const { t } = useTranslation()`: -> `const t = useNativeTranslationFallback()` (returns the English fallback string for each key).

L29 `const { vehicle, vehicles, vehicleId, setVehicleId } = useSelectedVehicle()`: preserved verbatim against the native `useSelectedVehicle()` defined in-file (same field names/shape: vehicleId, vehicle, vehicles, setVehicleId).
L30 `const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)`: preserved verbatim — the popover open/closed state machine is identical.

L31 `const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)`: dropped — the ref existed only for DOM outside-click hit-testing (L52-53), which is replaced by the Modal backdrop. RN has no HTMLDivElement.

L33-36 useVehicleState 60s comment + `useVehicleState(vehicleId ?? 0, { refetchInterval: 60_000 })`: preserved verbatim (same `vehicleId ?? 0` guard and 60_000 refetchInterval; the footer-tier polling comment is carried over).
